news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy representing over 500,000 covered lives, expanding incremental access for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results (period ended June 30, 2026) before market open on August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00 am ET the same day.

news.headline: NeurAxis Files Form S-3 Resale Registration Statement
news.summary: NeurAxis filed an S-3 registering the resale of 1,923,194 shares of common stock by selling stockholders/directors (999,418 resale shares plus 923,776 shares underlying RSUs), a technical filing that creates potential future dilution/selling pressure but is not itself a capital raise.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Series B Preferred Stock Dividend
news.summary: The Board approved a Q2 2026 stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (approximately 80,463 shares at a $2.38 calculation rate) on July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21, 2026.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with Four New Medical Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced four additional health insurers adopted medical policy coverage for PENFS/IB-Stim, adding roughly 1.25 million covered lives and continuing the post-Category-I-CPT-code payer rollout. No newer distinct catalyst emerged between late April and early July 2026, so this still-relevant item is retained to show the coverage-expansion trajectory.

news.headline: NeurAxis CEO and CFO Buy Shares in Open Market
news.summary: CEO Brian Carrico and CFO Timothy Henrichs each purchased shares on the open market at $1.96 (8,060 and 7,593 shares respectively), part of a broader cluster of insider buying that signaled management confidence ahead of Q1 2026 results.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will report Q2 2026 (period ended June 30, 2026) results before market open with a call at 9:00 am ET; analysts model continued double-digit revenue growth following Q1's 80% YoY gain. This falls just after this research cutoff.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Company continues to add regional/national medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim (most recently 500k+ covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic on Aug 4, 2026, following ~1.25M lives added in April 2026), building on the Category I CPT code that already covers 100M+ lives.

catalysts.label: Cash-flow breakeven target
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to roughly $15M in annualized revenue needed for cash-flow breakeven, alongside a targeted burn rate of about $1M/quarter or less for the remainder of 2026.

catalysts.label: Rectal Expulsion Device (RED) commercial relaunch
catalysts.detail: RED commercialization was paused following a CPT coding change in early 2026; management has indicated it expects clarity/resumption but has not given a firm relaunch date.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's quarterly reporting cadence, Q3 2026 results would be expected around mid-November 2026; no date has been officially announced yet.

pulse: NeurAxis remains in steady commercial-execution mode: IB-Stim keeps adding payer coverage (latest Mid-Atlantic policy expansion Aug 4, 500k+ lives, on top of ~1.25M lives added in April) as the Category I CPT code continues to unlock its full 100M+ covered-lives runway, while the Rectal Expulsion Device relaunch remains paused/TBD. A new S-3 resale registration (July 23) adds modest overhang alongside the existing ATM facility, and a routine Q2 preferred dividend was declared July 9, but no fresh capital raise has been announced and insiders (CEO/CFO) have been net buyers this year. All eyes now turn to Q2 2026 earnings on August 11, which will show whether the ~80% revenue growth pace from Q1 continued and whether the company is tracking toward its ~$15M revenue cash-flow-breakeven target.
